test.name: Attachment links present: build without extracting, events labelled unverified
test.description: Mode A on becker-attachment-links, the project after the attached-records step: John Becker's assertions in two census records are linked to I1 as unchecked attachment links. timeline_build writes his person timeline from them at the first call, so no extraction runs. The reply says how many events nobody has checked and that checking them is a separate request.

input.delegation:
Build the timeline for John Becker (person I1).

projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: I1 already has live attachment links, so the first `timeline_build` writes the timeline and no `extraction_append` call is made; the `extraction-calls-0` validator owns that. The record fixtures are loaded only so that a stray extraction would read them rather than fail.

`t_001` holds four events (a ~1845 birth from the 1910 census, the January 1845 birth from the 1900 census, the 1900 census and the 1910 census), every one starting "Unverified attachment:". Its gaps are both `high`: 1845-01 to 1900 naming the 1850, 1860, 1870 and 1880 United States censuses, then residence; and 1845-01 to 1900 naming marriage.

The reply's plain-language paragraph must say that the events come from records nobody has checked yet (all four here) and that checking those attached records is a separate request; a next step to verify them says the second. A paragraph that lays the events out in order and states they all come from unchecked records meets this; it need not hedge each sentence. A paragraph that never says the records are unchecked presents them as established facts, a Correctness fault.

In Mode A `timeline_build` resolves every place and computes every `distance_from_previous_km` itself, in code, so the agent makes no `place_search` or `place_distance` call and none is expected. Do not mark Tool usage or Tool Arguments down for their absence. `distance_from_previous_km` is `null` where either place has no coordinates.

Geographic feasibility is N/A: no two events are close in time and far in place. Identity coherence is N/A: there is no hypothesis. Deferral of logical-impossibility detection is N/A: nothing falls outside his lifespan.
